title: CGU 2026 Public Exam: 60 Auditor Vacancies with Salaries Over R$20K
seoTitle: CGU 2026 Exam: 60 Auditor Jobs, Salaries Over R$20K
subtitle: Official notice expected by December 24, with exams scheduled for December 2026
excerpt: The Comptroller General of the Union (CGU) announced a public exam for 60 Federal Auditor of Finance and Control positions, offering an initial salary of R$21,924.80.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Blog Gran Cursos Online, Magistrar, JC Concursos
contentHtml:
Last Friday, October 9, the Comptroller General of the Union (CGU) published in the Official Gazette the notice opening 60 immediate vacancies for the position of Federal Auditor of Finance and Control (AFFC). The release of the notice generated a large volume of searches, as the public exam offers an initial remuneration above R$21,000 and covers strategic areas such as auditing, data science, IT infrastructure, and systems development.

What the Notice Stipulates for Candidates

To compete, a higher education diploma in any area recognized by the Ministry of Education is required. Applications will be made exclusively online, on the official Cebraspe website, between October 10 and November 4, 2026, with a fee of R$170. The notice also defines the possibility of fee exemption for candidates who meet the established criteria.

Vacancy Distribution and Remuneration

Of the 60 vacancies, 50 are allocated to the CGU Central Office in Brasília, and 10 are distributed among the regional units in Acre, Amapá, Mato Grosso, Rondônia, and Roraima, with two vacancies per state. The expected initial remuneration for the position is R$21,924.80, potentially reaching R$36,694 at the end of the career, according to the remuneration table in effect in 2026.

Selection Stages

The public exam will be organized by Cebraspe, a board already contracted through Contract No. 17/2026, published in the DOU on November 1. The selection includes objective and discursive tests, both eliminatory and classificatory. The objective test will have 170 items, distributed among basic, complementary, and specific knowledge, and will be applied in the morning, lasting five hours. The discursive test, lasting three and a half hours, will be held in the afternoon and will be worth 100 points.

Preliminary Calendar

With the ordinance authorizing the public exam published on June 24, the notice must be released within six months, i.e., by December 24, 2026. The exams should take place at least two months after the publication of the notice, and are scheduled for December 2026 in all 27 Brazilian capitals.

Main Responsibilities of the Position

The Federal Auditor of Finance and Control acts in the supervision and coordination of internal governmental audits, in guiding agencies on risk management and internal controls, in preventing corruption, and in promoting governance and integrity. In Information Technology specialties, the position includes the implementation of technological solutions for CGU's activities.

With information from Blog Gran Cursos Online, Magistrar, JC Concursos.
